therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Epidural analgesia with ropivacaine and hydromorphone
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Regional anesthesia blocking pain transmission at spinal cord level
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Relative pain scores measured by Pain Numeric Rating Scale up to 24 hours post-surgery

results.effect_size: Mean difference -1.08 points (epidural 3.87 vs control 4.95 on 1-10 scale)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Epidural placement achieved with 0.1% ropivacaine + 10 mcg/mL hydromorphone at 6 mL/hr
biomarker_changes: IL-2 levels lower in epidural group (9.6 vs 15.5 nmol/L)
safety_signals: 4 epidural discontinuations prior to planned removal
1 wound infection/fascial dehiscence in epidural group
results.dose_information: 0.1% ropivacaine + 10 mcg/mL hydromorphone at 6 mL/hr continuous rate, 3 mL/hr RN bolus PRN, 3 mL/30 min patient bolus
